clips.title: The story
paras: At Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai holds a remote Horde beachhead against the Wrathtail naga. The Darkspear jungle troll coordinates efforts to drive the naga back along Ashenvale's foggy northwest coast.

At Zoram'gar Outpost, Marukai works to keep the encampment from being overwhelmed. The outpost sits on the northern edge of the Zoram Strand, surrounded by ancient ruins, hostile night elf territory, and the restless sea. Wrathtail naga emerge in force from the waters and ancient elven ruins to claim the shoreline. Marukai directs Horde champions to push them back into the tide and collect their heads, keeping the outpost a viable coastal stronghold.
